items.headline: Tesla misses on earnings, as free cash flow turns negative and margins slide
items.summary: Tesla's earnings report lands in the midst of a slide in the company's stock price even as its core auto business is rebounding.

items.headline: Google's Q2 earnings of $112.11B beat Wall Street's expectations on AI boom
items.summary: Google parent company Alphabet Inc. posted stronger-than-expected results for its second quarter, a sign that it’s massive artificial intelligence spending spree is paying off so far

items.headline: Amazon cuts some jobs in its artificial general intelligence unit
items.summary: Amazon's AGI unit has released a set of AI models, called Nova, and also includes groups working on silicon and quantum computing.

items.headline: U.S. signs nuclear power agreement with Saudi Arabia
items.summary: The agreement will provide U.S. companies with access to Saudi Arabia's nuclear energy program, the Department of Energy said.

items.headline: Senate crypto bill would ban federal officials — including presidents — from issuing digital assets
items.summary: A new version of the Clarity Act would impose the first limits on federal officials sponsoring or issuing cryptocurrency.

items.headline: John Paulson says we are in the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold
items.summary: He said demand for bullion continues to broaden, led by central banks that have been adding to their reserves alongside growing private-sector interest.

items.headline: Tesla's Disastrous Quarter: Margins Fall And Profits Slump (NASDAQ:TSLA)
items.summary: Tesla Q2 earnings: profit miss, margins deteriorate despite solid deliveries. Click for more on TSLA stock prospects.

items.headline: IBM lowers full-year forecast after earnings warning
items.summary: IBM is now looking to improve productivity with artificial intelligence, including with a new coding tool called Bob.

items.headline: House advances bill barring sitting Congress members from buying stocks
items.summary: The House on Wednesday advanced a bill that would bar members of Congress from purchasing additional stocks while in office.

items.headline: Analysis: Iran war energy shock hits the U.S. economy as gas and diesel prices climb
items.summary: A new asymmetry in the market means fuel prices won't fall quickly even if the shooting in the Iran war and Strait of Hormuz stops.

items.headline: Southwest Airlines' third-quarter forecast falls short as fuel bill climbs
items.summary: Southwest Airlines reported a more than 9% increase in second-quarter profit as higher fares are increasingly helping the airline cover its fuel tab.

items.headline: Senate panel advances China auto bill that could bar Mercedes-Benz from U.S.
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz’s largest individual shareholder is Chinese state-owned BAIC. Cruz warned the bill could hurt Mercedes and accused GM of backing it.

items.summary: ZeroHedge - On a long enough timeline, the survival rate for everyone drops to zero

items.headline: Ex-Google recruiter: Ask this 'insightful' question in an interview and I'll want to hire you 'on the spot'
items.summary: Former Google recruiter Farah Sharghi reveals the question that makes job candidates stand out to her the most.

items.headline: U.S. Secret Service official: 'Threat environment is the highest we've ever seen'
items.summary: The Secret Service has seen a 40% increase this year in cases involving threats to protectees, including President Donald Trump.

items.headline: EU antitrust regulators clear Paramount-WBD merger as it faces challenge by U.S. states
items.summary: European regulators signed off on Paramount's proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.headline: J&J gets a big win on its new robotic surgical system — plus, a flood of earnings
items.summary: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

items.headline: Houthis deploy missiles and drones to attack ships in southern Red Sea, naval group says
items.summary: Attacks on ships transiting the Bab el-Mandeb threaten to cut off millions of barrels per day of Saudi crude oil exports.

items.headline: OpenAI cyber models broke out of training environment to hack Hugging Face
items.summary: The incident is unique because it was "driven, end to end, by an autonomous AI agent system," according to Hugging Face.
